# Darshan Dye-Chem: full reference

> Darshan Dye-Chem is a manufacturer and exporter of acid dyes, direct dyes and specialty colourants based in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It supplies wholesale and bulk buyers in textile, leather and paper industries across India and overseas. Its shade cards show 139 dye shades with C.I. names and fastness ratings.

## About the company

Darshan Dye-Chem is a proprietorship led by Girish Patel (Founder & Proprietor). It manufactures dyes in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, and also supplies wholesale and retail. Product families: acid dyes (commonly used for nylon, wool, silk and leather), direct dyes (commonly used for cotton, viscose and paper) and other specialty colourants.

## Frequently asked questions

**Are you a manufacturer or a trader?**
Darshan Dye-Chem is a manufacturer, and also supplies wholesale and retail. We are based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

**Which dyes do you make?**
Our range includes acid dyes, direct dyes and other specialty colourants. You can browse every shade, with its ratings, in the shade explorer and download our shade cards as PDFs.

**Can I get a sample before ordering in bulk?**
Yes. Request a sample through the contact page with the dye and shade you need, and our team will confirm the details.

**Which dye is right for my material?**
Acid dyes are commonly used for wool, silk, nylon and leather, and direct dyes for cotton, other cellulosic fibres and paper. Try our dye finder or ask our team.

**Do you supply overseas buyers?**
Yes, export enquiries are welcome. Share your product, quantity and destination country and we will respond with options.

**How do I get pricing?**
Send us your requirement through the contact page, WhatsApp or phone with the dye name, quantity and delivery location, and we will reply with a quote.

**Can you match a specific shade?**
Send us your shade reference and requirement and we will advise what is possible.

**How do I get a price list or data sheet?**
Contact us with the products you are interested in and we will share pricing and available technical information.

## How to read the shade card data

Ratings are copied as printed on the shade cards. Light fastness uses a 1-8 scale; washing, perspiration and milling use a 1-5 scale; a dash means the card gives no rating. On the direct dyes card the milling column holds whole numbers such as 40 or 60, kept exactly as printed.
